name: Boomerang
description: The flagship thrill coaster at Fantasilandia — Boomerang is a classic suspended looping coaster that sends riders forward and backward through a complete loop and corkscrew inversions, delivering intense forces and high-speed thrills. The most iconic coaster at Chile's largest theme park and a must-ride for thrill seekers visiting Santiago. Min 130cm.

name: Raptor
description: A thrilling inverted coaster at Fantasilandia delivering high-speed sweeping turns and powerful forces — Raptor is one of the most popular and intense coaster experiences in Chile and a firm favourite with thrill-seeking visitors to Santiago's premier theme park. Min 130cm.

name: Volare
description: A spectacular flying coaster at Fantasilandia that places riders in a prone flying position and sends them through a dynamic layout of inversions and sweeping turns — Volare is the most unique and thrilling coaster experience at Chile's largest theme park. Min 140cm.

name: Twister
description: A classic wooden roller coaster at Fantasilandia delivering old-school thrills through a dramatic wooden structure — Twister is a beloved Chilean theme park institution and one of the most rerideable and characterful wooden coasters in South America. Min 120cm.

name: Wild Mouse
description: A wildly spinning wild mouse coaster delivering sharp unexpected turns and sudden drops — completely unpredictable with every ride and one of the most fun coaster experiences at Fantasilandia. Min 120cm.

name: Pirate Revenge
description: A thrilling water flume ride at Fantasilandia themed to pirate adventure — delivering an exciting journey through elaborate pirate environments and a dramatic soaking final plunge. The most popular water ride at Chile's largest theme park. Min 110cm.

name: Moby Dick
description: A classic Viking ship pendulum ride swinging to extreme heights — Moby Dick is one of the most popular and accessible thrill attractions at Fantasilandia delivering soaring views over Santiago. Min 120cm.

name: Top Spin
description: An intense spinning flat ride that flips and rotates riders through multiple axes simultaneously — Top Spin is one of the most disorienting and thrilling flat ride experiences at Fantasilandia. Min 130cm.

name: Air Race
description: A spectacular aerial flat ride that simulates stunt aircraft manoeuvres — Air Race delivers breathtaking spinning and looping movements with views over Fantasilandia and Santiago. One of the most visually spectacular flat rides in Chile. Min 130cm.

name: Disko
description: A high-energy spinning platform ride that oscillates while rotating — Disko delivers intense centrifugal forces and is one of the most exhilarating flat rides at Fantasilandia. Min 120cm.

name: Tagada
description: A wild spinning disc ride where riders sit on the edge of a spinning platform with no restraints — the Tagada is one of the most uniquely chaotic and fun attractions at Fantasilandia. Min 130cm.

name: Crazy Dance
description: A fun spinning family ride delivering enjoyable rotational movements — Crazy Dance is one of the most popular and accessible attractions at Fantasilandia for families and groups. Min 110cm.

name: Tren Minero
description: A classic family mine train coaster winding through a Chilean mining-themed environment — Tren Minero delivers accessible family thrills and is one of the most beloved family coasters at Fantasilandia. Min 100cm.

name: Black Hole
description: A thrilling indoor dark coaster at Fantasilandia delivering a completely disorienting high-speed ride through pitch darkness with unexpected turns and drops. Min 120cm.

name: Spider
description: A classic spinning flat ride delivering fun rotational forces as riders spin in individual gondolas on extending arms. One of the most popular family-thrill rides at Fantasilandia. Min 110cm.
